segments.name: private market solutions
segments.description: Structures, manages and monitors private market investment portfolios across private equity, venture capital and private credit for institutional and high-net-worth investors.
segments.evidence: We operate our business as a single operating segment, which is how our chief operating decision maker evaluates financial performance and makes decisions regarding the allocation of resources.

revenueModel.text: Institutional and high-net-worth investors pay recurring management and advisory fees on committed capital held in the specialized investment vehicles Ridgepost manages.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue is composed almost entirely of recurring management and advisory fees, with the vast majority of fees earned on committed capital that is typically subject to ten to fifteen-year lock-up agreements.
